# UCC IR - University of Cape Coast Institutional Repository

> A comprehensive digital repository preserving and providing open access to University of Cape Coast research, theses, dissertations, and scholarly publications.

UCC IR is the institutional repository for the University of Cape Coast in Ghana, managed through DuraSpace technology. It serves as a centralized platform for accessing academic research, student dissertations, faculty publications, and research data from across UCC's colleges and departments.

- Research Data

## Core Collections

- [UCC IR Home](https://ir.ucc.edu.gh/xmlui): Homepage for University of Cape Coast institutional repository
- [Theses & Dissertations](https://ir.ucc.edu.gh/xmlui/handle/123456789/23): UCC theses and dissertations collection for doctoral and masters research
- [Research Data](https://ir.ucc.edu.gh/xmlui/handle/123456789/7520): Research data collection from UCC faculty including Anaisie, Tseywu, Pius
- [UCC Research Output](https://ir.ucc.edu.gh/xmlui/handle/123456789/8823): UCC research output across colleges including agriculture, education, distance
- [University Publications](https://ir.ucc.edu.gh/xmlui/handle/123456789/22): UCC scholarly publications, journals, and conference proceedings collection

## Discovery & Navigation

- [Search](https://ir.ucc.edu.gh/xmlui/discover): Search and discovery interface for UCC IR research collections
- [Recently Added](https://ir.ucc.edu.gh/xmlui/recent-submissions): Recently submitted research and publications to UCC institutional repository
- [Community List](https://ir.ucc.edu.gh/xmlui/community-list): Directory of UCC departments and academic collections in repository
- [Browsing by Issue Date](https://ir.ucc.edu.gh/xmlui/browse): Browse UCC repository content by publication date

## Featured Research Articles

- [Work Attitude Among Staff in a Ghanaian University](https://ir.ucc.edu.gh/xmlui/handle/123456789/12251): Research article on staff work attitudes at UCC by Buabeng-Boateng
- [Students' Research Experiences as a Pre-Requisite for Research Informed Teaching in Higher Education](https://ir.ucc.edu.gh/xmlui/handle/123456789/12250): Educational research on student research experiences by Aboagye and Ankomah
- [Do reforms always pay off? A study of banking sector efficiency in Ghana pre and post 2017 clean up](https://ir.ucc.edu.gh/xmlui/handle/123456789/12249): Financial sector study on Ghana banking reforms by Anaisie
- [Revisiting the Urbanization-Emissions Nexus: Heterogeneous Effects and Urban Growth Thresholds in Sub-Saharan Africa](https://ir.ucc.edu.gh/xmlui/handle/123456789/12247): Environmental economics research on urbanization and emissions by Gamette
- [Female Body Shapes and Apparel Choice](https://ir.ucc.edu.gh/xmlui/handle/123456789/12248): Research data on female body shapes and clothing selection by Tseywu
